name: com.gossip.core
description:
-- QUICK SETUP --
Step 1 SDK installed - you are here.
Step 2 -> Click the Samples tab above -> Import.
Step 3 -> Window -> Gossip Analytics -> 1 - Quick Setup.
Step 4 -> Enter your 3 API Keys (Dev, Beta, Production) -> press Check Connection to verify.
Step 5 -> Window -> Gossip Analytics -> 2 - Instrumentation Manager -> select which objects to track.
Step 6 -> Press Play and verify your data appears in the Gossip Analytics dashboard.

samples.description:
Import this to finish setting up the SDK. Once imported:
-> Step 3: Window -> Gossip Analytics -> 1 - Quick Setup (places the manager and opens settings)
-> Step 4: Enter your 3 API Keys (Dev, Beta, Production) -> press Check Connection to verify
-> Step 5: Window -> Gossip Analytics -> 2 - Instrumentation Manager - select which objects to track
-> Step 6: Press Play and verify your data appears in the Gossip Analytics dashboard

_upm.changelog:
### Added
- Instrumentation Manager: Inline "Deselect Handler" button, color-coded footer with X/Y counts, Done button tooltip, per-tab loading indicators.
- Instrumentation Manager: Auto-detect player and auto-add all trackers on Open().
- Instrumentation Manager: Auto-assign Camera.main to headTransform (Posture Tracker) and cam (Eye Tracking) immediately after adding.
- Instrumentation Manager: Scene Health Check -- warns if XROrigin Tracking Origin Mode is Not Specified or XRInputModalityManager hand prefabs are unassigned.
- Instrumentation Manager: Per-tracker preAddHint / postAddHint copy with an Auto-assign Camera button in Case B.
- Instrumentation Manager: Shared tracker component cache in OnGUI() — 10 FindObjectOfType calls run at most once every 2 seconds instead of every repaint.
- Build Preprocessor: GossipBuildPreprocessor auto-disables EnableDebug before every build.
- Uninstaller: PackageCache cleanup removes all com.gossip.core@* cache entries on uninstall.

### Changed
- Done button color reflects build readiness (green / amber / orange-red).
- Tracker type lookups cached in GetTrackerType() — assembly scan runs once per domain load.
- VRPermissionsHandler: removed auto-creation; requires explicit Add button. Deselect no longer recreates the handler.
